san3.historicalAttributesHelp: Read-only: historical base abilities are disc definitions outside the native save. Restarting the game restores disc values. Custom officer abilities can be saved.
san3.customAttributesHelp: Save inside the game after editing. Custom abilities enter the campaign save, but a fresh title-screen Load uses the separate registration copy: load the same slot again from the strategic system menu to restore edited custom data. Checkpoints retain it directly. Recruitment uses final leadership; ability edits preserve existing troops.
san3.factionControlHelp: Choose Player or Computer, then preview and save. The game reads this flag when dispatching commands; it does not change the current turn order. Capture at the main map after closing any unfinished command.
san3.readonlyHelp: Unavailable in this state. Relationships and calculated totals are read-only.
san3.delegationHelp: Choose Direct, Military, Production or Adaptive, preview and save separately from other edits. The current command city and cities in battle are locked. A military or civil governor requires a delegated mode. This changes only administration, preserving other city flags; save inside the game to retain it.
san3.portHelp: Read-only geographic capability. Changing this flag alone would not establish compatible naval routes.
san3.hiddenSealHelp: Read-only discovery marker. Grant the seal through Treasures to update ownership and this marker together.
san3.cityPriceHelp: Food rates are rice units per gold; equipment prices are gold per unit. Prices must remain positive for trading.
san3.maximumPresetsHelp: Set all four templates to six abilities of 100 with zero extra points. On the game's allocation screen, press Left (increase) to confirm. This affects the current creation module only; templates do not enter native saves. Finish creating the officer and use the game's registration Save to retain that officer.
san3.presetSummary: The game adds {bonus} points; leave room to allocate all of them.
san3.presetHelp: Temporary creation defaults, not native-save data. Edit before allocation. Created officers can be saved normally, but these defaults reset on a cold boot or module reload. Keep a checkpoint to preserve them. Existing officers are unchanged.
san3.birthdayHelp: February permits 29 days; other months follow the game calendar.
san3.portraitHelp: Choose a portrait supported by this game. Unregistered slots stay unregistered; use the game to create an officer.
san3.lifespanHelp: Category 0–7 changes the age threshold for death checks; it is not an exact death age.
san3.actionCompleteHelp: Clearing this flag permits another strategic action. Assigned, dead or battling officers remain locked.
san3.serviceYearsHelp: Both counters are independently editable from 0 to 255, including for officers without a former faction. Native covert return calculates current plus prior years minus one; results outside 0–255 wrap around. Changing these values does not cancel a task or change membership.
san3.kanjiHelp: Up to three characters from this game’s character set. Unchanged names keep their original bytes.
san3.kanaHelp: Up to seven encoded kana bytes; a voiced kana uses two. Hiragana and katakana are accepted.
san3.namePresetsHelp: Fill all 68 custom names/readings and set all six abilities to 100. Preview before saving. Existing custom abilities are replaced; registration and city membership remain separate operations.
san3.finishRecoveryHelp: Clear the recovery countdown and its associated hold. Busy, dead, rebelling or battling officers remain locked; apply separately from their other live traits or structural changes.
san3.turncoatMonthsHelp: An independent 0–3 month countdown. This does not change faction or cancel a mission; apply separately from other live traits and structural changes.
san3.endInfiltrationHelp: End the covert relationship and clear elapsed covert months and origin faction. Current city, faction, role, army and prior service stay unchanged, including for free agents awaiting recruitment. This does not return the officer to the origin faction. Battle, death, unverified covert flags and conflicting rebellion or turncoat states remain locked. Choose only one covert operation.
san3.relocationHelp: At the game's normal city command menu, capture for editing, open Officers and select a person. Choose a different city in Move to city, preview, then save edits. Resume and reopen the officer list; save inside the game to retain the move. Moving disbands troops and clears training, morale and the action-completed flag. Save separately from other live attributes or ruler replacement. For several officers, choose the destination, select Copy to records targets, then Copy changed fields and preview all effects.
san3.relocationBlocked: Cannot move this officer yet: {reason} After resolving this, capture for editing again and select the destination in Move to city.
san3.relocationNoRoster: The officer is not in a city's serving, free or hidden roster. Use the appearance controls first.
san3.relocationRuler: This officer is a ruler. Appoint a successor first, then check whether the former ruler is still a governor.
san3.relocationGovernor: This officer is a governor. Select their city and appoint another officer as New governor first.
san3.relocationBattleOrDead: The officer is in battle or marked dead. Finish the battle, or revive the officer before moving.
san3.relocationTask: The officer is assigned a task. Finish or cancel that task first.
san3.relocationStatus: The officer has a recovery, covert or rebellion status. Resolve that status before moving.
san3.relocationEquipment: Weapons or ships are still assigned. Remove them through the game's military commands so their stock is returned first.
san3.rulerChangeHelp: Choose an idle officer serving this faction. A successor in another city makes that city the capital; the former ruler stays in the old capital as governor. Armies and player control are preserved. Review all leadership, advisor and delegation changes before saving.
san3.invalidRelocation: Cannot move this officer: check city lists, ruler/governor status, assigned equipment and ongoing actions.
san3.invalidRulerChange: Choose an idle, unequipped successor in the same capital; delegated or inconsistent leadership cannot be replaced.
san3.bookCopiesHelp: At most seven copies exist across all officers. Reduce another holder first when redistributing. Unique treasures and base abilities are preserved.
san3.treasureOwnershipHelp: Transfer or remove this unique item. Ownership and the officer inventory change together; claiming the hidden seal clears its discovery marker. Event custodians and busy officers remain locked.
san3.equippedTroopsHelp: Remove allocated weapons and ships before changing troop numbers; native equipment refunds depend on the current army size.
san3.invalidAppointment: Choose a qualified, idle officer in this city. Rulers and governors cannot be reassigned; civil officers must have no troops or equipment.
san3.appointmentHelp: Choose a qualified officer already serving here. Strategist: Intelligence or Politics 80+. General: Strength 85+, or Strength 70+ and Charisma plus average leadership 120+. Armies and loyalty are preserved; civil conversion requires no troops or equipment. Apply separately from relocation, succession, covert status and treasure transfers.
san3.appointAdvisorHelp: Explicitly replace the city strategist. The previous holder keeps their role; this does not change the governor. A newly appointed strategist fills a vacant seat automatically.
san3.battleMobilityHelp: Finish or cancel Move and return to your battle command menu before capturing. An open Move dialog caches points and can overwrite edits. The reviewed editor range is 0–90; this does not change future turns or strategic movement.
san3.battleInstructions: Temporary battle edits: keep a checkpoint to preserve this state; native-save persistence has not been verified. Close movement and selection dialogs, return to your battle command menu, then capture for editing. Troop and equipment edits reconcile inventory. An unfinished command may overwrite changes.
san3.invalidGovernance: Choose consistent, idle city leadership. Resolve ongoing tasks, covert status and battles before changing governors or rulers.
san3.governorHelp: Choose an idle officer already serving in this noncapital city. Armies stay intact; an armed civil predecessor becomes a military officer. Advisor and delegation changes appear in the preview. Apply separately from other structural operations.
san3.taskEffect0Help: Monthly base gain, subject to the native morale cap. A result below 17 grows by four each month.
san3.taskEffect1Help: Training gains this score plus elapsed months at settlement; it also affects morale. Unused stored data is preserved.
san3.taskEffect2Help: Native search uses this score with monthly random rolls. It does not guarantee discovery or recruitment.
san3.taskEffect3Help: Monthly settlement adds the native time bonus, caps development at 100 and adjusts cultivation and irrigation.
san3.taskEffect4Help: Monthly settlement may add a time bonus. Cultivation remains capped at 100.
san3.taskEffect5Help: Also feeds irrigation calculations. The limit of 13 prevents the original arithmetic from overflowing.
san3.taskEffect6Help: Amount added at monthly settlement; city commerce remains capped at 9999.
san3.taskEffect7Help: Choose a foreign owned city. This score controls report detail and grows by five per month; each spy has independent progress.
san3.taskEffect8Help: Treatment depends on elapsed months and epidemic conditions. The unused result value cannot be edited.
san3.taskGroupHelp: Updates all {count} participants in this city task group. Spies are individual. Preview affected officers before saving; the game applies results at monthly settlement.
san3.separateWorkflow: Apply task, membership, or status workflows separately from other edits so their dependent changes can be reviewed.
san3.equipmentUnavailable: Equipment exchange is unavailable: check source-city ownership, port access, stock shortages and inventory limits.
san3.armyEditHelp: Set zero to disband; training and morale are cleared. Creating an army initializes omitted training and morale to zero. No recruitment cost is charged. Tasks, recovery, covert activity and reserved equipment must be resolved first.
san3.recoveryMonthsHelp: Set 0 to recover immediately. A positive value starts or adjusts recovery; the game counts down each month. Existing retreat recovery retains its original behavior. Cancel any active task first.
san3.infiltrationMonthsHelp: Elapsed months, not months remaining (0–7). At 7, the next monthly update attempts to return the officer and army to the origin faction. A free agent waiting for recruitment begins this process after joining a faction.
san3.originFactionHelp: Change the origin used by an existing covert affiliation, turncoat state or pending rebellion plan. This does not immediately change current membership. The game uses this faction when resolving the existing state; current and prior service must remain safe for a covert return.
san3.rebellionFactionHelp: Choose a faction to establish a pending rebellion plan, or None to cancel it. The game resolves the plan through its monthly rebellion and combat rules. Outcomes can include casualties, expulsion, death or ownership changes. Cancelling only removes the plan and preserves the stored prior affiliation.
san3.battleEquipmentHelp: Weapons reserve one stock unit per whole 100 soldiers; ships reserve one vessel. Exchanges return old equipment before taking new stock from the same-faction source city. Current movement points are preserved. Shortages, stock overflow and ship exchanges outside ports are rejected.
san3.transferCityHelp: Transfer a noncapital city and its serving officers together, preserving its armies and stores. Officers receive loyalty 100 and one service year. Choose Neutral to release all serving officers locally and disband their armies. Resolve active tasks, covert activity and equipment first. The current command city cannot change owner; move a capital by succession first.
san3.incomingGovernorHelp: Choose a local free/hidden officer, or an idle non-governor from the receiving faction. An incoming army is disbanded. Select both the receiving faction and governor before previewing.
san3.deployInfiltratorHelp: Choose one covert operation per preview. Deploy an idle officer without troops or equipment to a foreign city as a free agent awaiting recruitment. Current membership, loyalty and training are cleared; the officer leaves any strategist seat. Their origin and prior service are recorded for a possible return.
san3.establishInfiltrationHelp: Turn an idle officer already serving here into an insider for the selected foreign faction. Current city, faction, army and role stay unchanged. Set prior service below; it replaces any stored value. Rulers, governors and conflicting states cannot be selected. Apply separately from deployment or ending affiliation.
san3.infiltrationPriorServiceHelp: Used only when establishing an insider. Together with current service, the value must total 1–256; the native return computes current plus prior service minus one. The preview shows any previous stored value being replaced.
san3.reserveInstructions: Temporary battle edits: keep a checkpoint to preserve reserve deployment state; native-save persistence has not been verified. Capture at a battle command menu. Use the game's Retreat and Deploy commands to move units off or onto the battlefield.
san3.reserveHelp: The original editor called this 'in battle', but the game also keeps it set after a unit withdraws into the city. Allowing deployment again preserves previous losses and morale; it does not place a unit on the map.
san3.lifeHelp: Hand over leadership and resolve missions first. Death removes the officer from city lists and passes belongings to their ruler, or returns them to the pool.
san3.revivalHelp: Revives a registered deceased officer as a free officer in this city. Former armies and missions are not restored.
san3.presenceHelp: Leaders hand over first; resolve missions and allocated equipment. Civil service joins this city's faction; free, hidden or not-yet-appeared states disband the army. Withdrawal to not yet appeared also requires returning all treasures and books. It removes city membership without rewinding historical appearance events; use an explicit appearance city to introduce the officer again.
san3.appearanceHelp: Unappeared registered officers enter the selected city's list. Civil service requires an owned city. Existing officers use relocation to change cities.
san3.shipbuildingHelp: Available in player-controlled ports without delegation. A positive value freely starts or adjusts a queue without spending gold or an officer's action. Set 0 to cancel: no ships are completed and no gold is refunded. At the native monthly settlement, a queue reaching zero adds two ships, capped at 100. Normal build times are 6/4/2 months; the stored ranges allow 7/7/3. Save in-game to retain queues across a fresh boot.
san3.mergeFactionHelp: Absorb every city, serving officer and army into the selected faction. The former ruler becomes an officer; allegiance, player control and contracts are reconciled. The current turn faction cannot be dissolved: merge the other faction into it, then change ruler if needed. Resolve active tasks and covert activity first.
san3.taskJoinHelp: Join a same-city group with fewer than ten participants. Its existing duration, progress and result are copied without changing current members or charging resources; this officer's action becomes completed. To create a group, assign the first officer normally, then let others join. Spies remain individual. Preview this operation separately from other task edits.
